title: PR #94: arch: implement P0 boundary contracts
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: True

Implements the outstanding P0 architecture contracts without moving implementation ownership into the ecosystem repository.

Contracts: Network/P2P, Identity/Trust, State Ownership, Global Authority Matrix, Canonical Interfaces/Events, Failure/Recovery.

Adds machine-readable contract set + JSON Schema + deterministic validator + exact-SHA CI. Updates ARCHITECTURE.md to bind the contract set and correct canonical migrated paths for L2/L3.

Standalone First, Ecosystem Second remains enforced: this repository defines system boundaries; component repositories retain implementation/build/test/release SSOT.

No implementation readiness is inferred from architecture presence. Exact-SHA CI evidence is required.
